result.summary: Found 1 issue: a major layout misalignment in the 'Fastest near you' carousel.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the middle 'Smash Bros Burgers' card is vertically offset downward compared to the neighboring cards, so its image, time badge, title, and delivery text do not align on the same baseline as the other cards in the row.
issues.suggestion: Align all carousel cards to the same top baseline with consistent image height and aspect ratio so images, badges, titles, and delivery labels line up evenly across the row.
